detail.description:
Starts with ledge drops and builds into class 5 before hitting a 15 foot drop. From here it mellows until the last section above town.  Be on the lookout for strainers.

For High Falls and more drops go to the bridge above the put-in and find a put in a ways upstream or hike up.
